digest.component_or_area: LLM code review criteria routing and threshold tuning
propositions: Model emits criteria synonyms 'sec' and 'documentation' that do not match packaged routing index entries, causing findings to fall to default 0.95 threshold instead of their criterion's tuned value.

A synonym normalization step must map 'sec' to 'security' and 'documentation' to 'docs' before routing lookup, without constraining the open criteria vocabulary or affecting project-supplied or arbitrary open dimensions.

The calibration document embeds five data-hygiene errors (A–E) comparing against the packaged index rather than the effective vocabulary; all corrections must explicitly state the distinction and affirm that the four approved blocking flips and impact table remain unaffected.
After normalization, a docs-criteria finding with impact > 0 must still surface and one with impact 0 must still be dropped, confirming impact-aware nit-suppression is unbroken.
Known-id membership must be resolved through effective_criteria (project overlay included), not the packaged index alone, as validated by tests with overlay-activated project criteria.
